versions.subject: Added CrachMapExec rules
versions.detection:
powershell_execution:
    CommandLine|contains: 'powershell.exe'
snippets:
    CommandLine|contains:
        - 'join*split'
        # Line 343ff
        - "( $ShellId[1]+$ShellId[13]+'x')"
        - '( $PSHome[*]+$PSHOME[*]+'
        - "( $env:Public[13]+$env:Public[5]+'x')"
        - "( $env:ComSpec[4,*,25]-Join'')"
        - "[1,3]+'x'-Join'')"
condition: powershell_execution and snippets

versions.subject: feat: multiple fixes and updates
versions.detection:
selection_img:
    - Image|endswith:
        - '\powershell.exe'
        - '\pwsh.exe'
    - OriginalFileName:
        - 'PowerShell.EXE'
        - 'pwsh.dll'
selection_cli:
    CommandLine|contains:
        - 'join*split'
        # Line 343ff
        - '( $ShellId[1]+$ShellId[13]+''x'')'
        - '( $PSHome[*]+$PSHOME[*]+'
        - '( $env:Public[13]+$env:Public[5]+''x'')'
        - '( $env:ComSpec[4,*,25]-Join'''')'
        - '[1,3]+''x''-Join'''')'
condition: all of selection_*
versions.spl: Image IN ("*\\powershell.exe", "*\\pwsh.exe") OR OriginalFileName IN ("PowerShell.EXE", "pwsh.dll") CommandLine IN ("*join*split*", "*( $ShellId[1]+$ShellId[13]+'x')*", "*( $PSHome[*]+$PSHOME[*]+*", "*( $env:Public[13]+$env:Public[5]+'x')*", "*( $env:ComSpec[4,*,25]-Join'')*", "*[1,3]+'x'-Join'')*")
